input_or_scenario: Push concept: wizard pushing gems onto altars in gothic dungeon
expected_behavior: Pipeline produces 5 solvable levels with themed rendering
actual_behavior: Live run RUN-03 produced 5/5 solvable levels with 0 debug cycles, 2,969 tokens, and gothic theme.
notes: Live API run 2026-04-14. Cleanest run; all levels solvable on first pass.

input_or_scenario: Level with box placed in corner deadlock, not on target
expected_behavior: QA Tester flags unsolvable; Developer routes to Debugger using C4; Debugger repositions box; re-test passes
actual_behavior: Initial level was unsolvable. Patched level was solvable in 14 moves. Routing criterion C4 triggered.
notes: Synthetic level used to verify deadlock detection and config-bug routing.

input_or_scenario: 5 levels where Level 3 has lower QA difficulty_rating than Level 2
expected_behavior: QA Tester flags non-monotonic difficulty-rating curve in report summary
actual_behavior: Non-monotonic difficulty_rating sequence [3,1,4] was detected as a violation.

input_or_scenario: Level unsolvable because grid is too small for 4 boxes
expected_behavior: Developer classifies as design_flaw using D2 and routes to Level Designer
actual_behavior: Correctly classified as D2 because 9 floor tiles is below the estimated 14 needed.
notes: Synthetic level used to verify D2 criterion.

input_or_scenario: Live slide pipeline: penguin sliding ice blocks across frozen lake
expected_behavior: Developer classifies unsolvable levels, Debugger patches, QA re-tests, and pipeline stops at the 3-cycle cap if failures remain
actual_behavior: RUN-02 improved from 2/4 solvable to 3/4 after Debugger patches, then finalized with logged failures after 3 cycles.
notes: Demonstrates QA -> Developer routing -> Debugger patch -> QA re-test feedback loop and bounded failure logging.

input_or_scenario: All 5 levels solvable but 1 diversity violation with similarity > 0.5
expected_behavior: Pipeline accepts result after one attempted fix instead of burning all 3 cycles
actual_behavior: route_after_qa() treats diversity as a soft failure once all levels are solvable; F-005 documents the hard-blocking failure and the fixed soft-fail policy.

input_or_scenario: Concept that tends to produce similar layouts, such as a simple box puzzle
expected_behavior: Developer checks pairwise similarity and rejects layouts with similarity > 0.5
actual_behavior: Identical layouts produced similarity 1.00 and were rejected. Different layouts produced similarity 0.10 and were accepted.

input_or_scenario: GameSpec with level_count=1, below Pydantic minimum 3
expected_behavior: Pydantic validation rejects malformed output, and retry or terminal failure is explicit rather than silent
actual_behavior: ValidationError was raised for level_count=1. Current Game Designer and Level Designer retry paths record generation_failed if the retry still fails validation.
notes: Does not claim a successful second response unless the LLM actually returns one.

input_or_scenario: Debugger determines fix needs more than 25% tile changes
expected_behavior: Debugger flags the issue as design flaw and Developer escalates to Level Designer next cycle
actual_behavior: Threshold configured at 25% of floor tiles; changes exceeding the threshold trigger escalation.

input_or_scenario: Level with 15x15 grid and 6 boxes that may timeout at 500K states
expected_behavior: QA Tester reports solvability=None for timeout; Developer routes as D4 to Level Designer
actual_behavior: Solver timeout at 500K+ states was classified as D4.

input_or_scenario: Bundled final demos: outputs/demo_game.html and outputs/demo_slide_game.html
expected_behavior: Both final demos render from sample configs with 5 BFS-verified levels and move-limit UI
actual_behavior: Verified sample_game_config.json and sample_slide_config.json: both contain 5 levels, all levels solve under the BFS solver, and rendered HTML includes moveLimit/Best UI.
notes: Re-verified after cleaning stale root outputs.

input_or_scenario: Slide concept: penguin sliding ice blocks across frozen lake
expected_behavior: Game Designer chooses slide mechanic; solver verifies with slide physics
actual_behavior: Live run RUN-02 chose slide mechanic with icy theme and reached 3/4 solvable after 3 debug cycles using 8,538 tokens.
notes: Live API run 2026-04-14. Demonstrates slide mechanic selection based on concept.
